label: Walking down the labels
subgoals: Start at the target and read its label D
Step to a neighbour whose label is exactly one less
Repeat until the source and mark the route's cells used

label: Counting shortest routes
subgoals: Treat label-increasing moves as edges of a DAG
Sum the counts of predecessors wavefront by wavefront
Read the target's count as the number of shortest routes

label: Tie-breaking for fewer bends
subgoals: Prefer the neighbour that keeps the current direction
Track the incoming direction in each state of the DAG
Minimise direction changes over shortest routes by dynamic programming
